title: A Cloud Function's executions, errors and latency over a window

generation.description: Decides the metrics: 1st gen cloudfunctions.googleapis.com/function/*, 2nd gen run.googleapis.com/* of the backing Cloud Run service

hasData.description: The executions query returned series with a positive count; false: Monitoring has nothing for the function in the window (not run, or the metrics are not in yet); null when the executions query failed

idle.description: executions is 0: the function ran nothing in the window. An idle function says nothing about errors; null when the executions query failed

executions.description: Sum of execution_count (1st gen) or request_count (2nd gen); 0 with no series (hasData false); null when the query failed

errors.description: 1st gen: executions with a status other than ok; 2nd gen: requests of class 5xx. null when the query failed or when there were no executions

errorRate.description: errors / executions; null when there were no executions or a count is unknown

byOutcome.description: Executions per outcome label value: 1st gen `status` (ok, error, timeout, crash, ...), 2nd gen `response_code_class` (2xx, 4xx, 5xx, ...); null when the query failed

latency.description: Percentiles over all the function's series in the window, in milliseconds (1st gen execution_times is converted from nanoseconds); null when all three queries failed, a percentile is null when its own query failed or there was no data

series.description: Time series Monitoring returned per query; 0 means no data in the window; null means the query failed

errorRateAboveThreshold.description: errorRate > the errorRateThreshold setting (strictly: equal is not above); null when the rate is unknown, which includes any window with no executions

latencyNearTimeout.description: p99 reached latencyTimeoutRatio of the function's timeout; null when there is no p99 or no timeout
